mostWorthwhile.text: Adding inhaled particles was most worthwhile: the planned picture shows both trapping in mucus and some material continuing toward the air sacs, setting up the need for another defense.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the already working lining to the body felt more like assembly than a new explanation, though it made the overall model coherent.

surprise.text: A few particles and bacteria passed the mucus layer, so the defense was shown as incomplete rather than an absolute barrier.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although adding separately named beating cilia after the lining already had cilia was a little repetitive. The resulting coordinated-wave description did clarify their action.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter because the sequence connects an everyday exposure to layered defenses, though the mostly constrained choices leave limited room for discovery. The planned pictures and prose do not establish how well students would understand it.
